entities.name: The Dark
entities.description: The fourth Magic expansion, and also the darkness created when the Sylex Blast lofted debris that blotted out the sun.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The climax of the Brothers' War, which lofted debris into the air and created the Dark.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war whose climax was the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: A fabled city in the east where persecuted wizards hid.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: A group in the west where persecuted wizards hid.

entities.name: Anti-magic religion
entities.description: A religion that came to power blaming magic and its users for the Sylex Blast and its effects.

events.summary: The Sylex Blast, the climax of the Brothers' War, lofted debris that blotted out the sun and created the Dark.
events.quote: The climax of the Brothers' War was the Sylex Blast , which lofted debris into the air blotting out the sun and creating The Dark .

events.summary: An anti-magic religion came to power, blaming magic and its users for the blast.
events.quote: an anti-magic religion comes to power, blaming the Sylex blast and its effects on all magic and its users

events.summary: Persecution of wizards led to the creation of the City of Shadows and the Conclave of Mages, where they hid.
events.quote: Persecution of these magic-using wizards led to the creation of the fabled City of Shadows in the east and the Conclave of Mages in the west

relations.note: Persecuted wizards, who hid in the Conclave.
